meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 触发发布流水线,把新版本送上 npm 并逐一核验产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发版都要手动跑工作流、还得检查构建产物是否齐全
copy.tagline_en: Trigger the publish pipeline to ship a new npm version and verify its artifacts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you cut releases by running workflows and checking the built artifacts

howto.what: 它把 Claude 变成发布经理:你给出 patch、minor、major 或明确版本号后,它触发 GitHub Actions 发布流程,轮询等待,并逐项核对 npm 包、GitHub release 与 Discord 公告等发布面。
howto.when: 当你提到 “publish”、“release” 等词,或要求把 oh-my-opencode 发到 npm 时接管。必须先给出一个发布类型,否则它会停下来问你。

say.note: 触发发布流程并核对产物
按新增功能的小版本发布
按这个明确版本号发布

howto.what_en: Turns Claude into a release manager: given patch, minor, major, or an explicit semver, it dispatches the GitHub Actions publish workflow, polls the run, and verifies npm packages, the GitHub release, and the Discord announcement.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "publish", "release" and similar, or ask to ship oh-my-opencode to npm. A release selector is required, otherwise it stops and asks you for one.

say_en.note: Dispatches the workflow and verifies artifacts
Ships it as a feature bump
